vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you pay to eat meals
vocabulary.example: Have you tried that new restaurant?

vocabulary.meaning_en: with a hot taste from chili
with a taste that is both sweet and a little sour
vocabulary.example: Sweet and sour chicken is not spicy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: rice cooked in oil with vegetables or egg
fish cooked with hot steam from water

vocabulary.example: They also have spicy noodle soup.

vocabulary.meaning_en: ask someone to come with you

vocabulary.example: Maybe we can go this weekend.

fine_lines.title: spicy vs mild vs sweet
fine_lines.explanation_ar: spicy حار، mild خفيف وغير حار، sweet حلو.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Spicy" = hot with chili. "Mild" = not spicy. "Sweet" = like sugar.

examples.sentence: This soup is too spicy for me.
Sweet and sour chicken is nice.

fine_lines.title: like vs don't like / doesn't like
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع he / she / it نقول likes و doesn't like. مع I / you / we / they نقول like و don't like.
fine_lines.explanation_en: With he/she/it: "likes" / "doesn't like". With I/you/we/they: "like" / "don't like".

expressions.phrase: Have you tried that new restaurant nearby?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل جربت ذلك المطعم الجديد القريب؟
expressions.example: Have you tried the new bakery nearby?

expressions.phrase: Their special dish is spicy food.
expressions.meaning_en: Talking about what a place is famous for.
expressions.example: Their special dish is grilled fish.
All this food talk! Now I'm getting hungry.

expressions.meaning_en: Your words make me want food.
expressions.example: Stop talking about cake. You are making me hungry!

expressions.phrase: We should go there together soon.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن نذهب إلى هناك معًا قريبًا.
expressions.example: We should visit the museum soon.

expressions.phrase: Maybe we can go this weekend.
expressions.meaning_ar: ربما نستطيع الذهاب في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.
expressions.example: Maybe we can meet on Friday.

expressions.phrase: Let's invite Jessica to go with us.
expressions.example: Let's invite Ali to come with us.
Don't worry. They have mild food too.

expressions.meaning_en: You can choose from many things.
expressions.example: The menu is big. There are many choices.

expressions.phrase: I will check their opening hours and make a reservation.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying what you will do to prepare.
expressions.example: I will call the restaurant and make a reservation.

grammar.title: Making plans: should / can / Let's
grammar.explanation_ar: We should + فعل = اقتراح قوي. Maybe we can + فعل = اقتراح لطيف. Let's + فعل = هيا بنا.
grammar.explanation_en: "We should + verb" (good idea), "Maybe we can + verb" (soft idea), "Let's + verb" (let us).
examples: We should go there together soon.
Maybe we can go this weekend.

grammar.title: Present simple negative: doesn't / don't
grammar.explanation_ar: للنفي في المضارع البسيط: he/she/it + doesn't + الفعل الأساسي. I/you/we/they + don't + الفعل الأساسي.
grammar.explanation_en: Negative present simple: he/she/it + doesn't + base verb; I/you/we/they + don't + base verb.

choices: Your words make me want to eat.
questions.explanation_en: Your words make me want food.
